change: Team auto-admission sample sufficiency now uses independent case clusters rather than raw run count.

paired_snapshot_fields.runs_total: All recorded repetitions, retained for rates and resource aggregation.
paired_snapshot_fields.independent_case_clusters: Count of distinct ProductEval case_id values in the mode snapshot.
paired_snapshot_fields.sample_sufficient: True only when independent_case_clusters reaches SUFFICIENT_SAMPLE_SIZE.

gate_behavior.legacy_snapshot_missing_case_count: Defaults to zero and denies auto-Team admission.

regression_tests_added: ProductEval: 30 repetitions of one case count as one independent cluster; 30 distinct cases count as 30.
WorkSwarm: directionally eligible gain with 30 repetitions but only 1/2 independent cases remains blocked by gate_auto.
